title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree, return the values of the nodes level by level from top to bottom. Nodes belonging to the same level should appear in the same list.
input: The root of a binary tree.
output: A list of levels, where each level contains the values of the corresponding nodes.
constraints: Number of nodes is in the range [0, 2000] -1000 <= node.value <= 1000
